title: Finite Gaussian Hermite Gram formula
source_anchor: F6 in source-only.json; proof topology P4.
target_statement: Let \(E\) be a finite-dimensional real inner-product normed space with its Borel structure, and let \(\gamma_E=\operatorname{stdGaussian}(E)\) be the centered identity-covariance Gaussian probability. Let \(H_j\) be the unnormalized probabilists Hermite polynomial and put \(h_j(w)=[x\mapsto H_j(\langle w,x\rangle)]\in L^2(\gamma_E)\). For a finite set \(S\subset\mathbb N\) and real coefficients \(c_j\), put \(F_{S,c}(w)=\sum_{j\in S}c_jh_j(w)\). For every finite \(S\), arbitrary real \(c_j\), and actual unit vectors \(w,z\), the Hilbert inner product is the following diagonal sum. Signed correlations, both endpoint correlations, degree zero and empty support are included.
